title: Privacy: a cloud erase whose reply fails to decode after the session erased goes down the throw path: the store keeps the record it held before the erase, and the person is told the erase was refused
evidence: Privacy item; first in order. ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudErase (:272-300) runs the erase and mirrors it before it answers. ios/HealthRoadmap/Engine/HealthEngine+Erase.swift:59 decodes that answer with try, so a decode failure throws after the erase happened (a rejection from the door at :58 takes the same path). ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift:190-193 catches it, sends eraseEnded failed and rethrows, so showErased (:200) never runs: erasures does not move and the store's record is the one it held before. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DataEraser.swift:185-188 turns the throw into .refused(EraseText.failed(...)), and :142 returns before the Apple Health, units and reminders steps. The person sees 'Nothing was deleted.' or 'Your record was not erased.' with the chat lines (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/EraseText.swift:79-85): a wrong answer about a deletion. A fix reads as much of the answer as it can, so an erase with no readable view takes the existing held path (RecordStore.showErased with no view), with a test. US-25 AC16g
